options.content:
# Test Suite Reference

| Dir | Test Name | What It Verifies |
|-----|-----------|-----------------|
| 01 | hub-cluster-ready | Hub cluster operational — Nodes exist |
| 02 | us-cluster-ready | Us spoke cluster operational — Nodes exist |
| 03 | fleet-registered | Fleet `ClusterProfile` for us exists on hub |
| 04 | observability-stack | LGTM stack healthy — Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo Ready |
| 05 | chainsaw-cronjob | Chainsaw runner CronJob exists in monitoring namespace |
| 06 | ingress-log-shipping | Ingress controller, Grafana ingress, event-exporter, Loki ready |
| 07 | oidc-trust | Multi-cluster OIDC trust — Dex tokens, JWKS, oidc-verifier |
| 08 | rotating-trust | Projected SA tokens, kubelet rotation |
| 09 | dashboard-metrics | Grafana dashboards + Prometheus metrics from bucket-binding-controller |
| 10 | tenant-isolation | Bucket claim lands in the tenant namespace, metrics carry tenant_id |
| 11 | dashboard-data | Grafana dashboards render actual Prometheus data |
| 12 | auth-configuration | Spoke kube-apiserver uses AuthenticationConfiguration (dual-issuer) |
| 13 | projected-sa-tokens | Hub-issued projected SA tokens — audience, file, issuer config |
| 14 | admission-guardrails | Platform Wins — ValidatingAdmissionPolicies, non-admin blocked |
| 15 | multi-tenant-isolation | Strict namespace isolation — no cross-visibility of claims or credentials |
| 16 | platform-admin-access | Platform-admin manages ClusterRoles, users blocked |
| 17 | eu-cluster-ready | eu spoke up and registered as VM-capable |
| 18 | kubevirt-ready | KubeVirt deployed on eu with hardware KVM |
| 19 | vmset-provisioning | VmSet expands into cloud-init Secret + request with tier cpu/memory |
| 20 | vmset-lifecycle | VMs run on eu, scale down highest index first, delete cleans up |
| 21 | vm-cloudinit | Cloud-init ran: marker in the VM serial log |
| 22 | vm-console-rbac | VM controller scope and tenant console/read tiers |
| 23 | vmset-unschedulable | Region without VMs → Unschedulable, delete not blocked |
| 24 | eu-storage-cluster-ready | eu-storage up; every spoke has a region label |
| 25 | ceph-rgw-ready | Ceph cluster + RADOS Gateway Ready, bucket StorageClass exists |
| 26 | bucket-provisioning | Bucket → quota request → bound claim → endpoint → S3 round trip |
| 27 | bucket-lifecycle | Ceph enforces maxSize/maxObjects; delete removes claim and credentials |
| 28 | bucket-tenant-rbac | Controller scope; tenant tiers; credentials only for admin/developer |
| 29 | bucket-unschedulable | Region without Ceph → Unschedulable, delete not blocked |

---
**Total: 29 test cases**  |  The CronJob runs 13 of them every 2 min (cronjob.tests); the rest via `make validate`
